verse_text_english: In the name of God, Most Gracious
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: T. H.*
verse_text_arabic: طه
verse_text_transliterated: tta-ha
verse_footnote_english: *20:1 The role of these Quranic initials as participants in the Quran’s awesome mathe­ matical miracle is given in detail in Appendix 1. 1 1608 T. H. (Taa Haa) 20:13-37 313
verse_text_arabic_clean: طه

verse_text_english: We did not reveal the Quran to you, to cause you any trouble.
verse_text_arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna litashq
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما أنزلنا عليك القرءان لتشقى

verse_text_english: Only to remind the reverent.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: illā tadhkiratan liman yakhsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا تذكرة لمن يخشى

verse_text_english: A revelation from the Creator of the earth and the high heavens.
verse_text_arabic: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verse_text_transliterated: tanzīlan mimman khalaqa l-arḍa wal-samāwāti l-ʿul
verse_text_arabic_clean: تنزيلا ممن خلق الأرض والسموت العلى

verse_text_english: The Most Gracious; He has assumed all authority.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: al-raḥmānu ʿalā l-ʿarshi is'taw
verse_text_arabic_clean: الرحمن على العرش استوى

verse_text_english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens, and the earth, and every­ thing between them, and everything beneath the ground.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wamā baynahumā wamā taḥta l-thar
verse_text_arabic_clean: له ما فى السموت وما فى الأرض وما بينهما وما تحت الثرى

verse_text_english: Whether you declare your convic­ tions (or not) He knows the secret, and what is even more hidden.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu yaʿlamu l-sira wa-akhf
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن تجهر بالقول فإنه يعلم السر وأخفى

verse_text_english: GOD: there is no other god besides Him. beautiful names.
verse_text_arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'n
verse_text_arabic_clean: الله لا إله إلا هو له الأسماء الحسنى

verse_text_english: Have you noted the history of Moses?
verse_text_arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wahal atāka ḥadīthu mūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهل أتىك حديث موسى

verse_text_english: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Stay here. I have seen a fire.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًى
verse_text_transliterated: idh raā nāran faqāla li-ahlihi um'kuthū innī ānastu nāran laʿallī ātīkum min'hā biqabasin aw ajidu ʿalā l-nāri huda
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ رءا نارا فقال لأهله امكثوا إنى ءانست نارا لعلى ءاتيكم منها بقبس أو أجد على النار هدى

verse_text_english: When he came to it, he was called, “O, Moses.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā atāhā nūdiya yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما أتىها نودى يموسى

verse_text_english: “I am your Lord. Remove your sandals; you are in the sacred valley, Tuwaa.
verse_text_arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verse_text_transliterated: innī anā rabbuka fa-ikh'laʿ naʿlayka innaka bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwa
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنى أنا ربك فاخلع نعليك إنك بالواد المقدس طوى

verse_text_english: “And I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-anā ikh'tartuka fa-is'tamiʿ limā yūḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا اخترتك فاستمع لما يوحى

verse_text_english: “I am GOD; there is no other god besides Me. You shall worship Me alone, and observe the contact prayers (Salat) to remember Me.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verse_text_transliterated: innanī anā l-lahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'bud'nī wa-aqimi l-ṣalata lidhik'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: إننى أنا الله لا إله إلا أنا فاعبدنى وأقم الصلوة لذكرى

verse_text_english: “The Hour (end of the world) is surely coming. I will keep it almost hidden. For each soul must be paid for its works.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-sāʿata ātiyatun akādu ukh'fīhā lituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā tasʿ
verse_subtitle_english: End of the World is Not Hidden*
verse_footnote_english: *20:15 The end of the world is given in the Quran, for it is God’s final message (15:87). 1 1609 T. H. (Taa Haa) 20:38-51 r
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الساعة ءاتية أكاد أخفيها لتجزى كل نفس بما تسعى

verse_text_english: “Do not be diverted therefrom by those who do not believe therein—those who pursue their lusts—lest you fall.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: falā yaṣuddannaka ʿanhā man lā yu'minu bihā wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu fatard
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا يصدنك عنها من لا يؤمن بها واتبع هوىه فتردى

verse_text_english: “What is this in your hand, Moses?”
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā til'ka biyamīnika yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما تلك بيمينك يموسى

verse_text_english: He said, “This is my staff. I lean on it herd my sheep with it, and I use it for other purposes.”
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla hiya ʿaṣāya atawakka-u ʿalayhā wa-ahushu bihā ʿalā ghanamī waliya fīhā maāribu ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال هى عصاى أتوكؤا عليها وأهش بها على غنمى ولى فيها مـٔارب أخرى

verse_text_english: He said, “Throw it down, O Moses.”
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla alqihā yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال ألقها يموسى

verse_text_english: He threw it down, whereupon it turned into a moving serpent.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-alqāhā fa-idhā hiya ḥayyatun tasʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: فألقىها فإذا هى حية تسعى

verse_text_english: He said, “Pick it up; do not be afraid. We will return it to its original state.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla khudh'hā walā takhaf sanuʿīduhā sīratahā l-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال خذها ولا تخف سنعيدها سيرتها الأولى

verse_text_english: “Hold your hand under your wing; it will come out white without a blemish; another sign.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-uḍ'mum yadaka ilā janāḥika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin āyatan ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: واضمم يدك إلى جناحك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء ءاية أخرى

verse_text_english: “We thus show you some of our great signs.
verse_text_arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verse_text_transliterated: linuriyaka min āyātinā l-kub'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: لنريك من ءايتنا الكبرى

verse_text_english: “Go to Pharaoh; for he transgressed.
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى

verse_text_english: He said, “My Lord, cool my temper.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi ish'raḥ lī ṣadr
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب اشرح لى صدرى

verse_text_english: “Make this matter easy for me.
verse_text_arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: wayassir lī amr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويسر لى أمرى

verse_text_english: “Untie a knot from my tongue.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-uḥ'lul ʿuq'datan min lisān
verse_text_arabic_clean: واحلل عقدة من لسانى

verse_text_english: “That they may understand me.
verse_text_arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verse_text_transliterated: yafqahū qawl
verse_text_arabic_clean: يفقهوا قولى

verse_text_english: “And appoint an assistant for me from my family.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ij'ʿal lī wazīran min ahl
verse_text_arabic_clean: واجعل لى وزيرا من أهلى

verse_text_english: “My brother Aaron.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
verse_text_transliterated: hārūna akh
verse_text_arabic_clean: هرون أخى

verse_text_english: “Strengthen me with him.
verse_text_arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: ush'dud bihi azr
verse_text_arabic_clean: اشدد به أزرى

verse_text_english: “Let him be my partner in this matter. 33. “That we may glorify You frequently.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ashrik'hu fī amr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأشركه فى أمرى

verse_text_english: "That we may glorify You frequently.
verse_text_arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: kay nusabbiḥaka kathīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: كى نسبحك كثيرا

verse_text_english: “And commemorate You frequently. 35. “You are Seer of us.” 36. He said, “Your request is granted, O Moses. 37. “We blessed you another time.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wanadhkuraka kathīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونذكرك كثيرا

verse_text_english: "You are Seer of us."
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: innaka kunta binā baṣīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنك كنت بنا بصيرا

verse_text_english: He said, "Your request is granted, O Moses.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla qad ūtīta su'laka yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال قد أوتيت سؤلك يموسى

verse_text_english: "We have blessed you another time.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad manannā ʿalayka marratan ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد مننا عليك مرة أخرى

verse_text_english: “When we revealed to your mother some revelation. 314
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: idh awḥaynā ilā ummika mā yūḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ أوحينا إلى أمك ما يوحى

verse_text_english: “Saying: ‘Throw him into the box, then throw him into the river. The river will throw him onto the shore, to be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his.’ I showered you with love from Me, and I had you made before My watchful eye.
verse_text_arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُۥ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verse_text_transliterated: ani iq'dhifīhi fī l-tābūti fa-iq'dhifīhi fī l-yami falyul'qihi l-yamu bil-sāḥili yakhudh'hu ʿaduwwun lī waʿaduwwun lahu wa-alqaytu ʿalayka maḥabbatan minnī walituṣ'naʿa ʿalā ʿayn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن اقذفيه فى التابوت فاقذفيه فى اليم فليلقه اليم بالساحل يأخذه عدو لى وعدو له وألقيت عليك محبة منى ولتصنع على عينى

verse_text_english: “Your sister walked, and said, ‘I can tell you about a nursing mother who can take good care of him.’ We thus returned you to your mother, that she may be happy and stop worrying. we saved you from grief, then we tested you thoroughly. years with the people of Midyan, and now you have come back in accord­ ance with a predetermined plan.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًا فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh tamshī ukh'tuka fataqūlu hal adullukum ʿalā man yakfuluhu farajaʿnāka ilā ummika kay taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynāka mina l-ghami wafatannāka futūnan falabith'ta sinīna fī ahli madyana thumma ji'ta ʿalā qadarin yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ تمشى أختك فتقول هل أدلكم على من يكفله فرجعنك إلى أمك كى تقر عينها ولا تحزن وقتلت نفسا فنجينك من الغم وفتنك فتونا فلبثت سنين فى أهل مدين ثم جئت على قدر يموسى

verse_text_english: “I have made you just for Me.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-iṣ'ṭanaʿtuka linafs
verse_text_arabic_clean: واصطنعتك لنفسى

verse_text_english: “Go to Pharaoh, together with your brother, supported by My signs. Do not waver in remembering Me.
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: idh'hab anta wa-akhūka biāyātī walā taniyā fī dhik'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهب أنت وأخوك بـٔايتى ولا تنيا فى ذكرى

verse_text_english: “Go to Pharaoh, for he transgressed.
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh'habā ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهبا إلى فرعون إنه طغى

verse_text_english: “Speak to him nicely; he may take heed, or become reverent.”
verse_text_arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: faqūlā lahu qawlan layyinan laʿallahu yatadhakkaru aw yakhsh

verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا لولا يأتينا بـٔاية من ربه أولم تأتهم بينة ما فى الصحف الأولى

verse_text_english: Had we annihilated them before this, they would have said, “Our Lord, had You sent a messenger to us, we would have followed Your revelations, and would have avoided this shame and humiliation.”
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw annā ahlaknāhum biʿadhābin min qablihi laqālū rabbanā lawlā arsalta ilaynā rasūlan fanattabiʿa āyātika min qabli an nadhilla wanakhz
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو أنا أهلكنهم بعذاب من قبله لقالوا ربنا لولا أرسلت إلينا رسولا فنتبع ءايتك من قبل أن نذل ونخزى

verse_text_english: Say, “All of us are waiting, so wait; you will surely find out who are on the correct path, and who are truly guided.” 0 1613 r / 322
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qul kullun mutarabbiṣun fatarabbaṣū fasataʿlamūna man aṣḥābu l-ṣirāṭi l-sawiyi wamani ih'tad
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل كل متربص فتربصوا فستعلمون من أصحب الصرط السوى ومن اهتدى
